s01F3DB.name: Yoshi: swallow sprite and draw tongue
summary: Tail of Yoshi's swallow routine (sprite $7E gives wings, others give the normal reward) and then the tongue code.

CODE_01F3FE draws the tongue as 5 OAM tiles from Yoshi's mouth, spaced by [$151C]/4. CODE_01F4B2 moves the sprite in Yoshi's mouth with the tongue tip, or ($160E negative) searches all sprites for one the tongue touches.

TryEatSprite.name: Check tongue contact with sprite
summary: Tests whether sprite Y touches Yoshi's tongue hitbox. Inedible sprites play a sound; edible ones fall into EatSprite.
Parameters: X: Yoshi, Y: candidate sprite.

EatSprite.name: Eat sprite: Pokey check
summary: Pokey sprites ($70) are split (SpltPokeyInto2Sprs); everything else goes to CODE_01F5FB.

SpltPokeyInto2Sprs.name: Split Pokey when eaten
summary: Removes the eaten segments from the Pokey, spawns a new Pokey at the tongue tip with the remaining segments, then marks the sprite as in Yoshi's mouth ($160E), tongue state 2 and timer $1558 = $0A.

s01F60A.name: Data: tongue X offsets per frame

s01F61A.name: Data: tongue Y offsets per frame

s01F622.name: Yoshi vs. other sprites contact
summary: Every frame, loops over sprites (half per frame) and checks contact with Yoshi's hitbox. Handles the wing item ($7E), kicked sprites that knock Mario off Yoshi, and specific enemies.

YoshiEgg.name: Yoshi egg main routine
summary: Waits for the hatch timer ($1540) or for Mario to come near ($187B set), shakes the egg, then spawns 4 shards (CODE_01F7C8) and turns into the sprite in $151C (baby Yoshi $2D, 1-up $78, or Yoshi $35).

s01F82D.name: Data: egg shard offsets and speeds

s01F83D.name: Turn egg into hatched sprite
summary: Becomes sprite [$151C]. Yoshi $35 gets Yoshi init; baby Yoshi $2D becomes carryable and keeps its color.

InitEerie.name: Init Eerie: X speed toward Mario
summary: Sets the X speed from EerieSpeedX depending on which side Mario is.

Eerie.name: Eerie and wave Eerie main
summary: Moves horizontally. The wave Eerie ($39) also accelerates vertically up to a limit and reverses. Interacts with Mario, animates and draws.

BigBoo.name: Big Boo main routine
summary: Start of the Big Boo routine (continues in the next chunk).
